summary_en: Kamgras 1 K.K. raised the offer price for Kakaku.com shares from 3,683 yen to 3,700 yen per share in its ongoing tender offer launched May 13, 2026. The offer period was extended by 10 business days to November 26, 2026, for a total of 134 business days.
title_en: Notice Regarding Changes to Tender Offer Conditions for Shares of Kakaku.com, Inc. (Securities Code: 2371) by Kamgras 1 K.K.
translation_en_brief: On November 11, 2026, Kamgras 1 K.K., the acquirer in an ongoing tender offer for Kakaku.com, Inc. (TSE Prime Market, code 2371), announced an increase in the per-share offer price from 3,683 yen to 3,700 yen. The conditional offer price remains at 3,720 yen. This price adjustment was made following a request from the target company on October 27, 2026. In conjunction with this change, the tender offer period was extended by 10 business days from November 11, 2026, bringing the total offer period to 134 business days, with the new closing date set for November 26, 2026. The offer was originally initiated on May 13, 2026. The disclosure notes that while the proposed offer price and conditional offer price have been raised, they remain below the KDDI price threshold (3,757 yen as of the latest update), a condition specified for the feasibility of the proposal dependent on KDDI's cooperation. The target company's board response and shareholder-related guidance announced on July 2, 2026, remained unchanged as of October 27, 2026.
